# Risk Radar

> An AI-assisted delivery-risk dashboard for Scrum and SAFe teams. It monitors backlog signals across Agile Release Trains, scores risks by Probability x Impact, and routes low-confidence AI flags to a human review queue. A single-page app in one HTML file: risk matrix, register, dependency tracking, audit trail and human-in-the-loop controls.

## What it does

- Scores delivery risks by probability and impact, shown on a risk matrix
- Keeps a risk register with dependency tracking and an audit trail
- Sends low-confidence AI flags to a human review queue instead of acting on them
